title: Amendment, Transfer and Household Cover Entitlements, Pass and Trip Protection
content:
Beyond the cover itself, a Pass and Trip Protection plan carries entitlements about what may be changed on it,
whether it may be moved to a different named insured, whether it stands for the whole household, and whether a
named concierge comes with it.

| Plan | Holding covered or beneficiary may be changed | Fee for that change (USD) | Plan may be moved to a different named insured | Covers the whole household | Dependants covered alongside the named insured | Named concierge included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | No | 0.00 | No | No | 0 | No |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | Yes | 20.00 | No | No | 0 | No |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | Yes | 20.00 | Yes | No | 0 | No |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | Yes | 25.00 | No | No | 0 | No |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | Yes | 25.00 | Yes | Yes | 3 | Yes |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | Yes | 6 | Yes |

**On amendment.** Five of the six plans allow the holding covered or the person a payout would be made to to
be changed. Season Pass Protection Basic allows neither, and carries a fee of 0.00 USD because the entitlement
does not exist on it. The Collective Total Protection Concierge plan allows the change and charges 0.00 USD
for it; the fee stands at 20.00 USD on the two Season Pass Protection plans that allow it and at 25.00 USD on
the two Collective Trip Protection plans that allow it.

**On household cover.** Only Collective Trip Protection Elite and the Collective Total Protection Concierge
plan stand for the whole household, covering 3 and 6 dependants alongside the named insured. The other four
plans stand for one named insured and cover 0 dependants. The same two plans are the only ones that include a
named concierge; Season Pass Protection Premier, Collective Trip Protection Elite and the Collective Total
Protection Concierge plan are the three that may be moved to a different named insured.
